findings.fix: Animate bubble and snack separately on the request clock, snap normal bubbles to chair 2, and display bar bubbles at the middle stool

findings.cause: Only plain snack image rendered regardless of request/carried counts
findings.fix: Use recovered hilite image while requesting groups exceed carried snacks
